frequency_question: How often do states under existential threat succeed in establishing domestic production of advanced foreign precision missiles within two years of initiating the effort?
membership_rule: Includes: sovereign states under direct conventional invasion establishing domestic manufacturing/assembly lines for advanced foreign guided munitions or cruise missiles. Excludes: licensed production in peacetime, low-tech small arms manufacturing, or mere maintenance/repair depots.

cases.name: Ukraine domestic production of Stugna-P/Neptune scale-up
Ukraine domestic FPV drone and basic UAV mass production
Ukraine domestic manufacturing attempts for complex western air defense/missiles

coverage_note: Small population due to the rarity of the specific conditions, supplemented by general wartime industrial mobilization base rates.
known_gaps: Extremely sparse historical data for advanced cruise missile transfer and domestic line stand-up during active war outside of Cold War superpowers.
skeleton: Total high-tech domestic ordnance localization initiatives under wartime conditions attempted by Ukraine since 2022, categorized by complexity.
multiplier: 2 hits out of 3 major initiatives attempted for high-tech vs low-to-mid tech scaling.
validity_reason: Wartime industrial adaptation baselines remain relatively stable over medium-term conflict durations.
